title: STICK QUEST ( PICK-UP STICKS CHALLENGE )
rules:
1. Game Setup:
    • Participants will compete in teams of two.
    • The same two participants must play in all three rounds.
    • Participants must pick only one stick at a time.
    • While picking a stick, no other stick should move.
    • If another stick moves, that attempt will not be counted.
    • Each participant will get 2 minutes unless mentioned otherwise.
  2. General Rules:
    • Each team must bring its own mobile phone for the online game. Tablets and laptops are not allowed.
    • Mobile phones will not be provided by the organizers.
    • Any technical problem must be reported immediately to the coordinators.
    • The score recorded by the coordinators will be final.
    • Any unfair practice may lead to elimination.
    • The decision of the judges and coordinators will be final.
  3. Round 1 - Online & Offline Challenge:

    How to Play:

    • Both participants will play at the same time.
    • Participant 1 will play the Pick-Up Sticks game online using the team’s own mobile phone.
    • Participant 2 will play using physical Pick-Up Sticks.
    • Both participants will get 2 minutes.
    • Each successfully picked stick will give 1 point.
    • The scores of both participants will be added together.
    • The teams with the highest total scores will qualify for Round 2.
  4. Round 2 - Switch the Roles:

    How to Play:

    • The qualified teams will continue to Round 2.
    • The participants will switch their roles.
    • The participant who played online in Round 1 will now play offline.
    • The participant who played offline in Round 1 will now play online.
    • Both participants will get 2 minutes.
    • Each successfully picked stick will give 1 point.
    • The scores of both participants will be added together.
    • The teams with the highest total scores will qualify for the Final Round.
  5. Round 3 - Final Round:
    • The finalists will play the physical Pick-Up Sticks challenge.
    • Both participants of each team will play one after the other.
    • Each participant will be given a fresh arrangement of sticks.
    • Each participant will get 90 seconds.
    • Each successfully picked stick will give 1 point.
    • The scores of both participants will be added together.
    • The team with the highest total score will be declared the winner.

    Tie-Breaker:

    • In case of a tie, one participant from each tied team will play a physical Pick-Up Sticks challenge.
    • Each participant will get 30 seconds.
    • The participant who picks the highest number of sticks will win the tie-breaker.
    • If the score is still tied, the other team members will play another tie-breaker.
